I replied to Dana in a thread on their message in #north-team. I said I'd noted their 1:1s are on Thursday this week, and offered to update the calendar invites or tell anyone about the move if they want.

I didn't change anything else, since Dana didn't ask for anything. GBrain had nothing about this week's 1:1s, but its search was keyword-only at the time, so a gap there doesn't prove there's nothing.
